repin_amendment_note: Phase 1 pinned commit 7b328a99...1234 was metadata-derived (METADATA_REVIEW_ONLY_NO_SOURCE_VENDORED) and does not exist upstream. Approved re-pin to real upstream HEAD 5a16ae23a4f1cb6886c44c0205f7b7e52a34c276 (main, 2026-07-17) with a real source archive downloaded and hash-verified. content_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the sorted '<sha256>  <relpath>' lines (LF, relpath without leading './') over the 443 vendored files, as computed by scripts/verification/verify_phase4_intake.py.
restore_amendment_note: 2026-08-22 amendment: media files (FilmAgent-pics, video-claw-pics, demo/logo images) restored after collateral deletion in the render-media purge (commit d213efb8), returning the tree to its intake size of 443 files. Intake-time values (443 files / 86a8af16...) preserved as intake_file_count / intake_content_sha256 for provenance.
canonicalization_amendment_note: 2026-08-25 correction: the previous file_count=457 / content_sha256=e81b45a0... were measured over a dirty dev worktree that contained 14 untracked .ruff_cache files under upstream/, so they could never match a clean checkout. Canonical values are computed over the 443 committed files' exact bytes (LF; .gitattributes pins third_party/** -text). Commit e8fd203 applied Ruff cleanup edits to 22 vendored python files after intake, which is why the canonical digest differs from intake_content_sha256.
